title: 设备本地控制
subtitle: 本地模型、边缘计算与智能处理
subtitle_en: Local models, edge computing and on-device intelligence
description: 在弱网或无网环境下完成识别、分析、推理和系统调用，让基地车到了现场依然可以运行关键 AI 能力。
description_en: Runs recognition, analysis, reasoning and system orchestration under weak or zero connectivity, keeping core AI capabilities alive wherever the vehicle goes.

title: 视觉 AI 识别
subtitle: 摄像头、视觉模型与事件识别
subtitle_en: Cameras, vision models and event recognition
description: 用于识别车内外的人、物、行为和状态变化，可支持异常靠近识别、车辆守护、驾驶行为监测及沿途目标检测。
description_en: Recognizes people, objects, behaviors and state changes in and around the vehicle — proximity alerts, vehicle guarding, driving behavior monitoring and roadside object detection.

title: 语音 Agent
subtitle: 语音采集、转写、LLM 语义理解与对话
subtitle_en: Voice capture, transcription, LLM understanding and dialogue
description: 用于采集现场语音内容，经本地 ASR 转写后交给 LLM 完成语义理解、推理和对话反馈，支持讲解、培训、问答与交流记录等场景。
description_en: Captures speech on site, transcribes it with local ASR, then hands it to an LLM for understanding, reasoning and conversational feedback — for guided tours, training, Q&A and conversation logging.

title: 无网通信 / 户外应急
subtitle: 离网通信、定位与路径记录装置
subtitle_en: Off-grid communication, positioning and route logging
description: 用于在低网络或无网络环境下支持通信、定位、路径记录和现场协同，让基地车在偏远地区也能继续工作。
description_en: Keeps communication, positioning, route logging and on-site coordination running in low- or no-network environments, so the vehicle stays operational in remote areas.

title: 环境感知
subtitle: 温湿度、二氧化碳、降雨量等传感器
subtitle_en: Temperature, humidity, CO₂, rainfall and more
description: 用于实时采集、记录和展示车内外环境数据，让基地车持续感知运行环境和周边环境变化。
description_en: Continuously collects, logs and visualizes environmental data inside and outside the vehicle, keeping it aware of its operating conditions and surroundings.

title: 定位与靠近感知
subtitle: 定位标签与近距离感知装置
subtitle_en: Positioning tags and proximity sensing devices
description: 用于识别区域内的位置关系、判断靠近行为，并触发相应的设备联动与空间感知。
description_en: Maps positions within an area, detects approach behavior, and triggers coordinated device responses.
